note: Starter entries drafted from public information in Nov 2026. They are NOT verified. Open each official link, confirm every detail, then set verified_on (YYYY-MM-DD). Exact pension amounts are left out on purpose because they change and sources disagree.

schemes.name: Ayushman Vay Vandana (under AB PM-JAY)
schemes.summary: Cashless hospital treatment for senior citizens aged 70 and above under Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY, with a dedicated Ayushman Vay Vandana card. Reported cover is up to Rs 5 lakh per year, shared on a family basis; seniors whose family is already in PM-JAY are reported to get an extra top-up for themselves.
schemes.eligibility: Indian citizens aged 70 or above. No income limit is reported.
schemes.documents: Aadhaar (Aadhaar e-KYC is required) and a mobile number.
schemes.how_to_apply: Visit pmjay.gov.in or beneficiary.nha.gov.in, or use the Ayushman App: check eligibility, complete Aadhaar e-KYC, then download the card. You can also ask at a Common Service Centre or the Ayushman help desk of an empanelled hospital.

schemes.name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (NSAP)
schemes.summary: A monthly old-age pension for elderly people from below-poverty-line households under the National Social Assistance Programme. The Centre gives a fixed small amount and most states add their own, so the total depends on your state.
schemes.eligibility: Age 60 or above and belonging to a BPL household as per the state list. Rules can differ slightly by state.
schemes.documents: Age proof, address proof and BPL or income details. The exact list depends on your state.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply through your state's social welfare or social justice department, local panchayat or municipal office, or the state pension portal. See nsap.nic.in for the national programme.

schemes.name: Senior Citizens' Savings Scheme (SCSS)
schemes.summary: A government-backed savings deposit for senior citizens, available at post offices and authorised banks. The interest rate is set by the government every quarter, so always check the current rate. Reported basics: a 5-year deposit that can be extended, with a maximum deposit of Rs 30 lakh (please confirm).
schemes.eligibility: Generally age 60 or above. Some retired people between 55 and 60 may qualify under conditions.
schemes.documents: Identity proof, address proof, age proof and photographs.
schemes.how_to_apply: Open an account at a post office or an authorised bank branch. Check the current rate and rules on the India Post website.

schemes.name: Rajasthan Social Security Pension (Old Age / Mukhyamantri Vridhjan Samman)
schemes.summary: Rajasthan's own monthly old-age pension under the Rajasthan Social Security Pension (RajSSP) system. The monthly amount has been revised several times and sources disagree, so check the current amount on the portal.
schemes.eligibility: Permanent residents of Rajasthan. Reported minimum age is 58 for men and 55 for women. Income and other conditions apply, so check the portal.
schemes.documents: Jan Aadhaar or Aadhaar, age proof, bank account details and an SSO ID. Other certificates may be needed.
schemes.how_to_apply: Register or log in at sso.rajasthan.gov.in and open the RajSSP application, or apply through your nearest e-Mitra centre. Status and eligibility can be checked on ssp.rajasthan.gov.in.
